title: Show HN: GET Together – A social network where you don't need POST to Post
summary: GET Together is a social network platform that cleverly uses HTTP method terminology in its branding, suggesting a developer-friendly approach to social networking. The project was submitted to Hacker News and received moderate community interest with 87 points and 43 comments.
problem_solved: Provides a social networking platform with a developer-centric theme and naming convention.
why_valuable: Its clever HTTP method wordplay makes it memorable and appealing to the developer community, creating natural marketing through the clever naming alone.
